name: Space Age
reacts_against: earthbound, historical design references entirely, styling furniture and fashion as if the near future would be lived on a spacecraft.
revivals: a recurring reference in atompunk/retrofuturist media

wiki_facts.key_motifs: Rockets, satellites, planets, stars, astronauts, flying saucers, atomic symbols, streamlined shapes, parabolas, fins, geodesic domes, capsules, clean lines, futuristic vehicles
wiki_facts.key_colours: White, silver, chrome, bright primary colors (red, blue, yellow)
wiki_facts.key_values: Optimism, technological progress, utopianism, scientific advancement, exploration, future orientation, modernity, convenience

findings: mostly muted — about 71% of the measured color is low-saturation (greys, dusty tones)
measured.caveat: Colors measured from the Aesthetics Wiki images as photographed and displayed on screen; actual materials vary, and screen colors are approximate.
